name: Lesser Dimension Door
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level alchemist/investigator 2, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 2, bard/skald 2, magus 2, summoner 2, summoner (unchained) 2, witch 2

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You teleport to a point you designate within range. This otherwise functions as the spell dimension door, except that you must have line of sight and line of effect to your destination for this spell’s effects to properly function.

You can’t take other creatures with you, but you can bring objects up to your maximum load.
